description: TradingView MCP tool answers served by tests/fakes/tradingview.py (ticket 31): get_documents, get_document_view and get_news (and, tickets 16b to 16d, the earnings-calendar and get_ohlcv answers: the calendar's answer shape was confirmed from a live call on 2026-10-16; the bars' keys are TradingView's documented ones), each file being one tool's JSON answer (the text the fake puts in the tools/call result's text content).
provenance: SYNTHETIC, hand-written for Atlas tests. No TradingView, Quartr or news content: every title, transcript line and headline is made up, the IDs are invented, and the links point at .test hosts. The shapes follow the tool answers described in docs/decisions.md (TradingView MCP findings, ticket 31) and backend/atlas/tradingview/client.py. No TradingView request was made from tests or while writing them.

files.calendar-lumentum.json: (ticket 16d; the confirmed shape, synthetic values) the earnings calendar's answer for NASDAQ:LITE on 15 Aug 2026: one row with the most recent report (release_date 11 Aug 2026) and the next (release_next_date 5 Nov 2026, next_date_confirmed false) for the quarter ending fiscal_period_end 30 Sep 2026; the row also carries the price, name, description and flag keys of the real answer, which Atlas must ignore
files.calendar-lumentum-moved.json: the same a week later: the next date moved to 12 Nov 2026 and confirmed (the fake answers it when `calendar` is set to '-moved')
files.calendar-lumentum-reported.json: after the report: release_date is now 5 Nov 2026 (the quarter Atlas had as the next one) and the next report is 4 Feb 2027, for the quarter ending 31 Dec 2026 (`calendar` '-reported')
files.calendar-lumentum-noisy.json: the first Lumentum row with a distinctive close (987.65) and made-up consensus keys (`eps_estimate_next_fq`, `revenue_estimate_next_fq`, `eps_surprise_fq`) that must appear in nothing Atlas stores (`calendar` '-noisy')
files.calendar-innolight.json: the answer for HKEX:3308: no row (TradingView leaves out a symbol it has no data for)
files.calendar-innolight-both.json: a row for HKEX:3308 on the same quarter end as Lumentum's (`calendar` '-both'; the fake answers Lumentum's calendar-lumentum.json row beside it)
files.documents-lumentum.json: get_documents for NASDAQ:LITE: a synthetic earnings call (transcript and summary views), a synthetic annual report (summary and pdf views, form 10-K) and a synthetic 2019 call outside the lookback
files.documents-innolight.json: get_documents for HKEX:3308: one synthetic call whose transcript view the fake answers with a tool error (not retrievable)
files.view-syn-view-1001-t.json: get_document_view of the synthetic call's transcript view: an astDescription tree of paragraphs with bold speaker labels and one br; the labels have the shapes production transcripts carry ("Name (Title, Firm)" for the company's officers and an analyst, "Operator" alone), and the analyst repeats the CEO's sentence (pilot-fixes ticket 22: an analyst's words are not the company's)
files.news-lumentum.json: get_news for NASDAQ:LITE: two synthetic headlines (one with a TradingView storyPath, one with a link only)
files.ohlcv-lumentum-adjusted.json: (ticket 16b/16c) the same bars later, the 1 July close restated (the fake answers it when `prices` is set to '-adjusted')
files.ohlcv-lumentum.json: (ticket 16c) get_ohlcv for NASDAQ:LITE in the documented bar shape `{t, o, h, l, c, v}`: five made-up daily bars, 30 June, 1, 2 and 6 July and 3 August 2026 (the tests' July window excludes the first and last)
